semiconductor_relevance: High — En-Liang Enterprise Co., Ltd. specializes in insulation materials and components specifically for semiconductor production equipment, including ion implanter bushings.
summary: En-Liang Enterprise Co., Ltd. (ELEC) is a leading provider of electrical insulation materials and components for the semiconductor industry, particularly known for their ion implanter bushings. Established in 1983, the company has expanded its capabilities to include custom-made current transformers and polymer composites, serving both domestic and international markets.
capabilities: Ion implanter bushings for semiconductor production equipment
Custom-made current transformers compliant with international standards
Development and manufacturing of polymer composites (BMC and Epoxy)

regional_presence.Taiwan: ELEC has two manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, one focused on composite materials and the other on current transformers.
